newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Weifu 96 net reaches 67 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Weifu 96 net reaches 67 mln yuan.

text.p: Weifu Fuel Injection Co Ltd had net profits of 67.39 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Wednesday.
Earnings per share was 0.37 yuan and turnover reached 425.33 in 1996, the exchange said.
It did not say whether the figures were based on Chinese or international accounting standards.
According to Weifu's 1995 annual report, the company posted net profits of 62.98 million yuan on turnover of 393.42 million under international accounting standards.
In 1995, earnings per share was 0.34 yuan on a fully diluted basis.
The company proposed a cash dividend of 0.1 yuan per share based on 1996 profits, the exchange said.
Trading in Weifu's shares will be suspended on Thursday morning and will resume in the afternoon, the exchange said.
